channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, Australia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Helpmann Fellowships 2026
    https://helpmannacademy.com.au/helpmann-fellowships/
    Helpmann Academy · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Up to AUD 7,500 per fellowship, three fellowships available. Supported by the James & Diana Ramsay Foundation. No application fee.
  • Creative Australia: International Engagement Fund (October 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/international-engagement-fund
    Creative Australia · deadline 13 Oct 2026 · AUD 5,000 to 30,000. No application fee. No formal matching requirement, but assessment explicitly weighs diversity and scale of income and co-funding, including earned income, grants, sponsorship and in-kind contributions.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Creative Australia: Arts Projects for Organisations (September 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/arts-projects-organisations
    Creative Australia · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · AUD 20,000 to 100,000. No matching or co-financing requirement. No application fee. Organisational administrative costs should generally not exceed 10 percent of the total project budget or the application becomes less competitive.
  • Queer Screen Mardi Gras Film Festival 2027 Submissions
    https://queerscreen.org.au/submissions/
    Queer Screen · deadline Rolling / undated · Screening at one of the world's biggest queer film festivals, with audience awards. Modest FilmFreeway fees.

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• Eloquence Art Prize 2026
    https://powerinstitute.submittable.com/submit
    Power Institute, University of Sydney (Culture+) · deadline Closed 31 May 2026 · National public speaking prize (award for the winning art talk on French and Australian cultural ties). No application fee.
  • Nicholas and Angela Curtis Cite Internationale des Arts Fellowships 2026 (Curtis Artist Fellowships)
    https://powerinstitute.submittable.com/submit
    Power Institute, University of Sydney · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · $13,000 AUD towards travel and living costs, plus rent-free access to the Power Institute's living/working studio at the Cite Internationale des Arts for 3 months. Note: fellows pay a refundable bond deposit and utility costs. No application fee.
